description: Defines the FilterInvestFinishEvent class, which is an event class in a PHP project handling investment finish events, including logic for generating appropriate HTTP redirect responses based on investment and session data.

classes.name: FilterInvestFinishEvent
classes.description: An event class for handling actions after an investment is finished, providing accessors for the investment, request, and response, as well as logic to generate redirect responses based on session and investment data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with an Invest object and an HTTP request.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Returns the Invest object associated with this event.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with this event.

methods.name: setHttpResponse
methods.description: Sets an HTTP response object for this event.

methods.name: getHttpResponse
methods.description: Returns an HTTP response; if not set, generates a redirect response based on session data and investment details.
